title.narrative: RS! Zambia-Textiles Cotton

description.narrative: To contribute to a responsible, inclusive and climate smart global cotton and textiles value chain, in which smallholder cotton farmers in Africa benefit from decent work, earn a living income, get fairer value in the chain and ecosystems are protected. The main objectives of the project are The target groups are producers tea association, national association of small scale tea growers, agricultural workers union, women's groups, civil society groups. Objectives 1. To create, strengthen and/or join in dialogue to enhance access to knowledge, information and credible evidence, where vulnerable groups are included and policy makers can make informed decisions. 2. To strengthen the ability of civil society to claim and defend their rights and influence decision making 3. To mobilise activate and engage citizens and CSOs to change norms and influence the policy agenda for the range of issues highlighted in the problem analysis
